title: Radford 32x32 BN-DCGAN Convergence & B=256 Throughput Guard
intuition: Bounded hermetic 1,200-step diagnostic guard running a standard Radford 32x32 BatchNorm DCGAN (B=256, z_dim=128) on a continuous 10-class RGB image distribution (pooled 8x8 nn/med > 0.50) to catch BatchNorm critic train/eval collapse, optimizer period-2 limit cycles, natural-image quality regressions, and O(B^2) spatial-transport latency cliffs before promotion.
failure_mode: Switching active critic BatchNorm layers to eval() during the G step causes immediate critic collapse; firing O(B^2) pixel-space transport on continuous 32x32 images pushes B=256 latency above 38 ms/step and degrades quality; BatchNorm optimizer limit cycles or low-rank critic penalty inflation stall convergence.
protocol_notes: Hermetic research_diagnostic task (qualification_input=false; 1,200 updates, B=256, seed 0, deterministic_orthogonal_ init, isolated RNGs, SHA-256 verified updates.jsonl latency trace, actual-training goal.gif).
